title: Moroccan Sweet Potato Sellou
description: A traditional Moroccan dessert made with sweet potatoes, perfect for a warm evening. This sweet potato sellou is a delicious and comforting treat.
instructions: Poke some holes in the sweet potatoes with a fork and bake for 45-60 minutes, or until tender.
Let the sweet potatoes cool down.
Peel the sweet potatoes and mash them in a large bowl.
Add the ebullient, sellou, milk, and honey to the bowl. Mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for an additional 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Serve warm, garnished with a sprinkle of sellou, if desired.
